text:
The bowl looks like a small bowl, roughly 12-15 cm across. It holds what looks like one or two green (spinach) dumplings or wontons in red chili oil sauce with herbs.

A dumpling weighs about 25-30 g, so two wontons come to roughly 60 g. The sauce is perhaps 30 g, which brings the total to about 90-100 g.

Energy: the dumplings are about 60 g at roughly 2 kcal/g, so about 120 kcal. The chili oil sauce adds about 60 kcal. That gives roughly 180 kcal.
